_meta.description: KDP paperback interior and cover specs. The ONLY place specs live. All lengths in inches.

pageCount._rangesNote: [min, max] per inkPaperType, in the order listed above. null = not available.
pageCount._conflict: KDP's page lists A4 (8.27x11.69) twice: premium color max 590 in one table and 780 in the other. Using the stricter value, 590, until confirmed.

images._note: appVeryLowBelowDpi is OUR threshold, not a KDP rule. KDP only states 300 minimum. Both levels are warnings: KDP doesn't block low-DPI images.

file._maxSizeNote: Checked as decimal MB (650,000,000 bytes), the stricter reading of KDP's "650MB".

app._note: OUR settings, not KDP rules. KDP publishes no measurement tolerance.
app._sizeToleranceNote: 0.02" comes from a real approved book: a 63-page LibreOffice interior at 5.512" x 8.5" (140 mm wide) on a 5.5" x 8.5" trim went live on KDP with no issues (Nov 2026). KDP publishes no tolerance; this is our setting.
app._renderDpiNote: Pages are rendered at this DPI to find ink; margin measurements are accurate to about 1/renderDpi inch.
app._minImagePixelsNote: Images narrower or shorter than this many pixels are treated as fills, lines or gradients, not pictures, and skipped by the DPI check.
app._edgeInkNote: Ink this close to a page edge counts as touching it (bleed checks).
app._barcodeEdgeNote: Barcode area: a pixel is an edge when one RGB channel differs from its right or lower neighbour by more than barcodeEdgeContrast (0-255). Flat colours and smooth gradients have none. The area is flagged when edges add up to more than barcodeMinEdgeIn inches, or a text item sits in it. Owner decision Nov 2026: KDP's white box covers a plain background harmlessly.
app._inkThresholdNote: A pixel counts as ink when its darkest RGB channel is below this (0-255). 250 ignores near-white paper tints.

transparency._note: KDP's cover page says 'Flatten all transparencies'; it has no interior rule. Interior transparency is advice only (info).

cover._note: Paperback cover rules (Phase 2). Owner-verified against KDP's help pages on 2026-11-06. One PDF: back cover, spine and front cover side by side, with bleed on all four outside edges.

size._formula: width = bleed + trim width + spine + trim width + bleed; height = bleed + trim height + bleed

spine._note: Spine width = page count x per-page thickness for the ink and paper. Also listed on the submission guidelines page.

safeArea._note: Text and important images at least this far inside the trim on the outside edges.

spineText._note: KDP allows spine text from 79 pages; its Cover Creator tool only adds spine text from 80 pages.

fold._note: The fold between spine and covers can shift by this much either way when the book is bound.

barcode._note: KDP prints the barcode on the back cover, bottom right: keep this box empty with a white background, at least clearanceIn from the spine and the trim.

images._note: Owner decision Nov 2026: real KDP covers at 177 DPI were accepted, so low DPI on a cover is Good to know. Interior stays warn.
